description: Source code implementing ASN.1 encoding/decoding and parameter management for elliptic curve keys in OpenSSL's BoringSSL fork, including functions for encoding, decoding, comparison, and parameter handling of EC keys.

methods.name: eckey_pub_encode
methods.description: Encodes EC public key into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: eckey_pub_decode
methods.description: Decodes ASN.1 data to EC public key.

methods.name: eckey_priv_decode
methods.description: Decodes ASN.1 data to EC private key.

methods.name: eckey_priv_encode
methods.description: Encodes EC private key into ASN.1 format.

methods.name: eckey_set1_tls_encodedpoint
methods.description: Sets EC key from TLS encoded point.

methods.name: eckey_get1_tls_encodedpoint
methods.description: Gets TLS encoded point from EC key.

methods.name: ec_bits
methods.description: Returns bit length of EC key.

methods.name: ec_missing_parameters
methods.description: Checks if EC key parameters are missing.

methods.name: ec_copy_parameters
methods.description: Copies EC parameters from one key to another.

methods.name: ec_cmp_parameters
methods.description: Compares EC parameters of two keys.

methods.name: eckey_opaque
methods.description: Checks if EC key is opaque.
